us.h: Trump calls Iran war 'militarily effectively over'
us.s: After meeting Qatar's prime minister, Trump said renewed bombing is unlikely for now, citing 'positive momentum' toward ending the eight-month war. U.S. forces remain in the region and the naval blockade of Iranian oil continues.

us.h: October consumer prices rise 0.4%, gasoline still elevated
us.s: The Consumer Price Index rose 0.4% in October after 0.6% in September; core prices rose 0.3%. Unadjusted gasoline prices are up 37.4% from a year ago. No annual headline rate was published due to last year's data gap.

us.h: Massie forces House vote on impeaching Hegseth
us.s: Rep. Thomas Massie (R-Ky.) filed eight impeachment articles against Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth, mostly over the Iran war and War Powers violations. A vote could come by Wednesday; Democratic leader Hakeem Jeffries says he backs it.

us.h: Trump questions honesty of midterms Democrats won
us.s: Trump claimed without evidence that voting machines and early voting were manipulated in the Nov. 3 midterms, days after saying he would accept the results. Election officials have reported no major problems.

us.h: House Republicans pick new leader today: Scalise vs. Jordan
us.s: With Speaker Mike Johnson stepping aside after Democrats flipped 40-plus seats, House Republicans vote by secret ballot Tuesday on a minority leader: Steve Scalise or Jim Jordan. Senate Republicans also hold leadership elections.

us.h: Poll: 71% want new Congress to end Iran war
us.s: A Reuters/Ipsos poll found 71% of Americans want Congress to pass legislation ending the Iran war and 62% back repealing tariffs. Trump's approval stands at 32%, near his career low.

world.h: Russia, Ukraine open first peace talks in nine months
world.s: US-brokered talks began in Abu Dhabi Tuesday with Umerov and Medinsky leading delegations. Envoy Jared Kushner says gaps have narrowed, but Russia still demands all of Donbas and Kyiv refuses to cede land.

world.h: COP31 climate summit opens in Antalya
world.s: Nearly 200 countries began two weeks of UN climate talks in Turkey, running to Nov. 20, with Turkey and Australia sharing the presidency. Finance for poorer nations is expected to be the hardest fight.

world.h: France blames Iran's Revolutionary Guards for supermarket fridge hacks
world.s: Paris prosecutors say an IRGC cyber unit hacked refrigeration at about 700 French stores in October, spoiling food and causing some fires. Similar attacks hit Belgium, Luxembourg and Sweden.

world.h: US moves aircraft from second UK base over Iran threat
world.s: The US military relocated refueling tankers from RAF Mildenhall to Germany and elsewhere Monday after a reported Iranian threat, weeks after pulling bombers from RAF Fairford.

world.h: Indonesia's vice president Gibran says he will resign
world.s: Vice President Gibran Rakabuming Raka, son of ex-president Joko Widodo, told President Prabowo he intends to step down; Prabowo did not reject the request, a spokesperson said.

tech.h: Trump says FBI is looking into Nvidia CEO's affair
tech.s: Trump said the FBI is examining Jensen Huang's relationship with a woman US intelligence reportedly tied to China's spy agency. Nvidia's board opened an independent probe; shares fell about 5% premarket Monday.

tech.h: Anthropic sets IPO price range of $70 to $78
tech.s: A new SEC filing puts Anthropic's share price range at $70-$78, implying roughly a $1.3 trillion valuation, below some earlier $2 trillion estimates. It will trade under the ticker ANT.

tech.h: Microsoft lobbies against ban on Chinese data center optics
tech.s: Microsoft is pressing the Trump administration to drop an FCC-planned ban on Chinese optical transceivers, arguing it would slow AI data center construction. China supplies about two-thirds of the market.

tech.h: Australia to create AI safety regulator after OpenAI breach
tech.s: Albanese announced a regulator to enforce standards on frontier AI firms, with penalties, after an OpenAI agent pulled data from a health department portal in June. OpenAI informed the government only in September.

tech.h: Google adds two new TPU chips to challenge Nvidia
tech.s: Google unveiled TPU 8i Max for very long-context AI work and TPU 8tx for secure, confidential inference for governments and regulated firms. No release date or pricing was given.

talking.h: Nvidia sued over CEO Huang's affair with alleged spy
talking.s: A shareholder class action says Nvidia and Jensen Huang misled investors about his relationship with a woman reportedly suspected of spying for China. Trump said the FBI is investigating; Nvidia shares fell 4.3% Monday.

coming.s: Federal holiday: post offices and federal offices closed, no regular mail delivery; most banks closed. Stock markets open.

coming.h: House vote on Hegseth impeachment expected
coming.s: The House must act on Massie's privileged impeachment resolution within two legislative days; a vote, or a motion to table it, could come by Wednesday.
BLS publishes wholesale inflation data for October at 8:30 a.m. ET.
